name: city
title: The Release as a City
kicker: Servers are districts, resources buildings, links streets
html:
The Release as a City

Read as HEART, this slide links a script (deck:code) that draws the city and walks ARTIE through it. Without it, the route: forge index, scm:pulls-get to 501; by bookmark to the watcher, watcher:watch, rest; back to 501, scm:merge; by bookmark to the CI wrapper, ci:build, rest; hr:in-reply-to to the build; ci:smoke-test and ci:deployment to the library; by bookmark to Dev, env:get-environment, env:promote.
say: Same map, as a city. Each server is a district. Each resource is a building. Each link is a street, named by its relation. ARTIE never gets a street map: it reads the signs at every corner. Three times it takes a cab, a bookmark from the goal's inputs. At the watcher and at Jenkins it sits and naps until the reply's answered. Press the walk: at every crossing Claude reads the signs and picks. Press the replay: same streets, faster, and at every crossing the sign is checked against the pin, and nobody's asked.
